subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

ACQUIT
solution:
The correct answer is: Condemn

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Acquit means to state formally that a person is not guilty of a crime.

 
 
• Example - *The jury **acquitted **her of murder.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Condemn means to say what somebody’s punishment will be; to sentence somebody.
 
 
• Example - *The murderer was **condemned **to death.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Acquit' and 'Condemn' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 2.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Leave means to go away from someone or something, for a short time or permanently.
 
• Relieve means to make an unpleasant feeling or situation stop or get better.
 
• Replace means to use somebody/something in place of another person or thing.
